input.content: You are an independent PLC verification engineer. Return ONLY a JSON list of test cases.

You are an independent PLC test engineer. Generate comprehensive unit test cases for the specified PLC function block.
CODESYS Simulation Timing & Edge Rules:
- dt_ms advances elapsed PLC scan time for that step; TON/TOF timers accumulate dt_ms across consecutive steps while IN keeps its active state (e.g., IN=TRUE for TON).
- Rising-edge detection (R_TRIG or x AND NOT prev_x) requires a step with x=FALSE before the step with x=TRUE.

Return a JSON array of test case objects. Each test case must have:
- id: string identifier (e.g. 'case_1')
- steps: array of steps, where each step has:
    - inputs: dictionary of input variable names and values
    - expected: dictionary of expected output variable names and values
    - dt_ms: (optional) cycle elapsed time in milliseconds

TASK SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF006",
  "title": "Tank filling with hysteresis and sensor inconsistency",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "requirements": "# SELF006: Tank Hysteresis Fill Controller with Contradiction Detection\n\n## Background\nTank fill controller using low/high float probes with contradictory sensor fault protection.\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `LowWet` (`TRUE` when level >= low probe), `HighWet` (`TRUE` when level >= high probe), `Inhibit` (`BOOL`).\n2. `SensorFault := HighWet AND NOT LowWet` (physically impossible probe combination).\n3. If `SensorFault = TRUE` or `Inhibit = TRUE` or `HighWet = TRUE`, force `Fill := FALSE`.\n4. Else if `LowWet = FALSE`, set `Fill := TRUE`; otherwise retain previous `Fill`.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `LowWet: BOOL`, `HighWet: BOOL`, `Inhibit: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `Fill: BOOL`, `SensorFault: BOOL`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `Fill=false`, `SensorFault=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\nBoth outputs reflect post-evaluation state on every scan.",
  "scenario": "A refill tank avoids contactor chatter between low and high level switches and detects physically inconsistent switch combinations.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "LowWet",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Water reaches lower switch"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "HighWet",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Water reaches upper switch"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Inhibit",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "External fill inhibit"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Fill",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Inlet valve command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "SensorFault",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Inconsistent level switches"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "Fill": false,
    "SensorFault": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Inconsistent sensors or Inhibit stop filling",
    "High switch stops",
    "Low switch starts",
    "Middle level retains"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "LowWet": "I[k].LowWet: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "HighWet": "I[k].HighWet: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Inhibit": "I[k].Inhibit: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Fill": "O[k].Fill: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "SensorFault": "O[k].SensorFault: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "qFill": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Fill\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Fill; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "middle": "LowWet & !HighWet.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Fill=false, O_init.SensorFault=false."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF006.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF006.P1",
      "formula": "G(SensorFault <-> (HighWet & !LowWet))",
      "explanation": "Fault exactly identifies inconsistent switches.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF006.P2",
      "formula": "G((SensorFault | Inhibit | HighWet) -> !Fill)",
      "explanation": "Inhibit, fault and full tank force shutoff.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF006.P3",
      "formula": "G((!LowWet & !HighWet & !Inhibit) -> Fill)",
      "explanation": "A low tank starts filling.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF006.P4",
      "formula": "G((middle & !Inhibit) -> (Fill <-> qFill))",
      "explanation": "The middle band retains the prior command.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF006.P5",
      "formula": "G(first -> !qFill)",
      "explanation": "No retained filling command exists on reset.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
Output budget: at most 2 cases, at most 8 steps per case. Use compact JSON. Cover a complete normal path and one important boundary. Keep reasoning concise enough to finish the entire JSON within the output budget.
